versions.content: The API Dem_SelectExtendedDataRecord triggers the Dem internal extended data record selection process on the event memory assigned to the ClientId. The Dem shall provide the result of the selection process in the re- turn value of the API calls following the Dem_SelectExtendedDataRecord , see [SWS_Dem_01272].
